chunk_map.heading: It reads the whole conversation every time

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: l1 header 'It' resolves to 'The LLM' in the first body sentence (l4); 'That is context' (l6) continues l4; 'Your first prompt and its answer' is self-defined. Closest to violating: header pronoun 'It' (l1) precedes its antecedent, but the antecedent lands in the first sentence of the same chunk. Harm (unresolvable referent) absent.
l4-6: no pointer to another file or to a prior slide by position; grep for 'opening|earlier|lecture|module' in body: none.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no 'the X you did/saw/caught' backward reference in body

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no demo or guess-before-reveal beat; slide is a statement

rules_evaluated.evidence: l4-6: chunk carries a self-contained claim (the model reads the whole conversation; that is context; steer with it). Not a wait-state.
l1 header 'It reads the whole conversation every time' is exactly what l4 states; no bolded leads; nothing contradicts it.

Closest: l4 'Change the front, change the back.' is a pair, not a triple. No 'Not X. Not Y. Z.', no superlative (the former 'every useful thing in this training is built on' is gone), no number+retraction, no abstraction stack, no verb triplet. grep 'Not .*\. Not ' -> 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: l4-6 vocabulary: LLM, conversation, prompt, context, agent; all ordinary engineering terms. No surface/firing/compendium/beat/mood. Mechanical greps in body view CLEAN.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c '\*\*' on file -> 1, and that hit is the maintainer Quality line (l10); body bold count 0, within <=1 budget.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: slide file with no phase wrapper; reaches the deck via host include, no section-level presence at stake here

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no Phase/Step headers or ordinals; node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js --file -> 'OK — 1 files, Phase/Step numbering consistent.'

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/slides/reads-whole-conversation.md -> 'OK — 1 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut.' (exit 0)

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no links in body (signals has_urls false, no include or markdown links)

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/slides/reads-whole-conversation.md -> 'slides: 1 oversized: 0' (exit 0); body ~50 words, 0 bullets.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: l1 'It reads the whole conversation every time' is a claim-shaped heading, correct for a lecture slide (lecture headings = claims).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: l6 'You steer your agent with context.' could read as an aphorism kicker (class c), but it adds the payoff the slide owes (what context is for) and does not restate the header, which is about reading the whole conversation. No doctrine restatement or design commentary; the former 'Unglamorous, isn't it?' line is cut.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: header unchanged in diff b58bcc4c..HEAD (only body and maintainer block changed); no retitle
